author: Tường
notes: 30/30 query có phương án đạt kiểm chứng P95/hash, còn chờ Hải review; không khẳng định tối ưu toàn cục. Đáp án có rewritten_sql/required_indexes/requires_rewrite phải dùng đủ SQL và index kèm theo. Các gt_trial index được dọn sau đo. Kiểm tra composite_order_check cho nhóm 2. Chưa đo đầy đủ chi phí ghi/dung lượng.

acceptable_answers.note: Covering index đã giảm P95 88,61% và giữ nguyên hash kết quả; ứng viên chờ Hải review, chưa khẳng định tối ưu nhất. Index đang INVISIBLE.

explain_check.source: EXPLAIN FORMAT=JSON kiểm tra sau khi đo, với use_invisible_indexes off/on

acceptable_answers.rewritten_sql: SELECT YEAR(o.order_date) AS y, MONTH(o.order_date) AS m, SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders AS o FORCE INDEX (gt_trial_q02_good_0) JOIN addresses AS a ON a.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE a.city = 'Ha Noi' GROUP BY YEAR(o.order_date), MONTH(o.order_date)

SELECT p.category, SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue FROM products AS p JOIN (SELECT i.product_id, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS i FORCE INDEX (gt_trial_q04_good_0) ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.total_amount > 100000 GROUP BY i.product_id) AS s ON s.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category

SELECT a.city, SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders AS o FORCE INDEX (gt_trial_q06_good_0) JOIN addresses AS a FORCE INDEX (gt_trial_q06_good_1) ON a.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY a.city

SELECT a.city, SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders AS o FORCE INDEX (gt_trial_q07_good_0) JOIN addresses AS a FORCE INDEX (gt_trial_q07_good_1) ON a.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY a.city

SELECT p.category, SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue FROM products AS p JOIN (SELECT i.product_id, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS i FORCE INDEX (gt_trial_q08_good_0) ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.total_amount > 10000 GROUP BY i.product_id) AS s ON s.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category

SELECT o.status, SUM(i.quantity) AS sold FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS i FORCE INDEX (gt_trial_q10_good_0) ON i.product_id = p.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE p.category = 'Sach' AND p.price > 1000 GROUP BY o.status

SELECT o.status, SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue FROM addresses AS a JOIN orders AS o FORCE INDEX (gt_trial_q11_good_0) ON o.customer_id = a.customer_id WHERE a.city = 'Ho Chi Minh' AND a.address_id > 100000 GROUP BY o.status

SELECT p.category, SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue FROM products AS p JOIN (SELECT i.product_id, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS i FORCE INDEX (gt_trial_q12_good_0) ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'shipped' AND o.order_date >= '2023-06-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY i.product_id) AS s ON s.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category

SELECT p.category, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue FROM orders AS o FORCE INDEX (gt_trial_q13_good_0) JOIN order_items AS i FORCE INDEX (gt_trial_q13_good_1) ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY p.category
SELECT a.city, SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN addresses a ON a.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.order_date>='2024-11-01' AND o.order_date<'2024-12-01' GROUP BY a.city

SELECT p.category, SUM(i.quantity) AS sold FROM orders AS o FORCE INDEX (gt_trial_q15_good_0) JOIN order_items AS i FORCE INDEX (gt_trial_q15_good_1) ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY p.category

SELECT p.category, SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY p.category

SELECT p.category, SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue FROM products p JOIN (SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity*unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items WHERE unit_price>4900 GROUP BY product_id) s ON s.product_id=p.product_id GROUP BY p.category

SELECT o.status, SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price) AS revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items i ON i.product_id=p.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=i.order_id WHERE p.category LIKE 'Dien%' GROUP BY o.status

SELECT o.* FROM orders AS o FORCE INDEX (gt_trial_q19_good_0) STRAIGHT_JOIN addresses AS a ON a.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND a.city = 'Ho Chi Minh' ORDER BY o.order_date DESC, o.order_id DESC LIMIT 1000

SELECT i.* FROM order_items AS i FORCE INDEX (gt_trial_q20_good_0) STRAIGHT_JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Dien tu' ORDER BY i.unit_price DESC, i.order_item_id DESC LIMIT 1000

SELECT o.* FROM orders AS o FORCE INDEX (gt_trial_q21_good_0) STRAIGHT_JOIN addresses AS a ON a.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE a.city = 'Da Nang' ORDER BY o.total_amount DESC, o.order_id DESC LIMIT 1000

SELECT i.* FROM order_items AS i FORCE INDEX (gt_trial_q22_good_0) STRAIGHT_JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' ORDER BY i.quantity DESC, i.unit_price DESC, i.order_item_id DESC LIMIT 1000

SELECT i.* FROM order_items AS i FORCE INDEX (gt_trial_q23_good_0) STRAIGHT_JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Thoi trang' ORDER BY i.unit_price DESC, i.quantity DESC, i.order_item_id DESC LIMIT 1000

SELECT o.* FROM orders AS o FORCE INDEX (gt_trial_q24_good_0) STRAIGHT_JOIN order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id STRAIGHT_JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE p.category = 'The thao' ORDER BY o.order_date DESC, o.total_amount DESC, o.order_id DESC LIMIT 1000
acceptable_answers.note: Bỏ khóa phụ i.order_item_id: các dòng cùng o.order_id có o.* giống hệt nhau, giữ nguyên thứ tự giá trị và số lần lặp của kết quả.

acceptable_answers.rewritten_sql: SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o JOIN (SELECT customer_id, AVG(total_amount) AS avg_amount FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) s ON s.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.total_amount>s.avg_amount GROUP BY o.status

SELECT p.category, SUM(i.quantity) AS sold FROM order_items AS i FORCE INDEX (gt_trial_q26_good_0) JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id JOIN orders AS o FORCE INDEX (gt_trial_q26_good_1) ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY p.category

SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders AS o LEFT JOIN order_items AS i FORCE INDEX (gt_trial_q27_good_0) ON i.order_id = o.order_id AND i.quantity = 4 WHERE i.order_item_id IS NULL GROUP BY o.status

SELECT a.city, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers c JOIN addresses a ON a.customer_id=c.customer_id JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM orders WHERE status='completed') s ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id GROUP BY a.city

SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT i.order_id FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE p.category='Dien tu') s ON s.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY o.status

SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM addresses FORCE INDEX (gt_trial_q30_good_0) WHERE city = 'Ha Noi') AS a STRAIGHT_JOIN orders AS o FORCE INDEX (gt_trial_q30_good_1) ON o.customer_id = a.customer_id STRAIGHT_JOIN LATERAL (SELECT 1 AS found FROM order_items AS i FORCE INDEX (gt_trial_q30_good_2) WHERE i.order_id = o.order_id AND i.unit_price > 5000 LIMIT 1) AS hit ON TRUE GROUP BY o.status
acceptable_answers.note: MySQL >=8.0.14: JOIN LATERAL lấy tối đa một dòng hàng khớp cho mỗi đơn, DISTINCT customer_id tránh nhân bản vì nhiều địa chỉ; giữ ngữ nghĩa IN khi có NULL/trùng. Phải dùng đầy đủ SQL và các index kèm theo.
